questions.stem: A plant is moved from a cool, still room to a warm, windy environment. What would happen to its transpiration rate?

options.text: It would increase because both higher temperature and wind speed increase transpiration
It would decrease because the plant closes its stomata in wind
It would stay the same because the two factors cancel out
It would decrease because warm air holds less moisture

questions.explanation: Both higher temperature and increased wind speed increase transpiration. Higher temperature causes more evaporation from mesophyll cells, and wind removes the humid air layer around the leaf, maintaining a steep diffusion gradient.
